name: Scrapbook
what_it_means: Scrapbook design recreates a handmade journal: polaroid photos, torn paper, washi tape, stamps, doodles and handwritten notes on textured paper. It feels personal, nostalgic and human, perfect for storytelling and community-driven brands.
signature_moves: Paper textures: kraft, notebook, torn edges
Polaroids and photos held with tape
best_for: Travel blogs, personal portfolios, community & lifestyle brands
prompt_template: B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ] ** Design a travel-journal homepage for [BRAND / PERSON] in a Scrapbook style. Kraft-paper background (#E9DCC4) with subtle paper texture. Place 3 polaroid photos (white frames, 6px padding, slightly rotated -6° to 8°) held by semi-transparent washi-tape strips in pink #F2A7A0 and mint #9CC9B5. Add a yellow sticky note, a torn-paper text block, a postage stamp and hand-drawn doodle arrows. Headline in Permanent Marker, notes in Caveat, body in a typewriter font. Nothing perfectly aligned; elements wiggle slightly on hover.
